name: My Pack Name
_help: Copy this file to a new name without the leading underscore, e.g. calvin.json.
Files starting with '_' are ignored, so this template never gets loaded.
BLACK cards: use four underscores ____ for each blank. 'pick' is inferred from the blank count.
A plain string is fine. Use {"text": "...", "pick": 2} only when you need to force a pick count.
WHITE cards: one string each. Keep them short (about 60 characters) so they fit on the card.
Delete this _help key if you like; it is ignored by the game.
